gates.name: repo hygiene (documented rules vs reality)
gates.why: R1-R6: workflow branch refs, workflows README, UTF-8 text, gates tracked, line endings, branch/dir collisions

gates.name: every tracked script dependency is tracked
gates.why: a file read by a tracked script but not itself tracked is absent from a clean checkout
gates.lastLine: OK - every untracked FILE read by a tracked script is accounted for.

gates.name: geo contract (world-grid)
gates.why: frozen projection, grid, origin and valueKind; 18 assertions

gates.name: export boundary
gates.why: no fact-shaped prose may reach the exported guide

gates.name: city pack (stock contract gate)
gates.why: the contract gate that existed before any pack; checks provenance PRESENCE
gates.lastLine: 22 place(s), 9 transit leg(s), all facts carry provenance.

gates.name: city pack (fact-layer gate)
gates.why: provenance ADEQUACY: URLs opened, per-entry sources, counts re-derived, enum imported

gates.name: recorded values appear in the source they cite
gates.why: D-14: check A proves a URL resolves; this proves the VALUE is in that source and not a different one
gates.lastLine: PRESENT 21   AS-PARTS 10   OSM-ELEMENT 9   ABSENT 0   NEAR-VARIANT 0   UNKNOWN 4   UBIQUITOUS 0

gates.name: scene emit (real geometry through the frozen projection)
gates.why: real OSM geometry through a projection whose assertions had only ever seen a synthetic fixture; rejection, determinism, traversal independence

gates.name: scene.bin is readable from its bytes by a reader that is not the emitter
gates.why: Gate 1 needs a walkable world and nothing reads the scene today; this is the second independent reader of the container, which is the posture emit-guide chose when it stopped trusting it

gates.name: doors (strict release gate)
gates.why: --strict, because a declared blocker must fail the release gate

gates.name: pack build is reproducible
gates.why: 9 stages; exits non-zero if validation fails, so it doubles as a reproducibility check

gates.name: guide export (the door that finally has something behind it)
gates.why: the export boundary proved in task-4 asserted a door with nothing behind it; this asserts the artefact, including that the guide refuses to describe a scene baked under a different contract

gates.name: walkable shell (the world, walked)
gates.why: a collision-constrained walker follows the drifting street centreline end to end; doors present and reconciled with the export; frames deterministic

gates.name: the baked page actually runs
gates.why: the page own JavaScript executed headlessly against a DOM stub -- that it baked is not that it runs

gates.name: evidence storage norm (where bytes may live, and whether git tracks them)
gates.why: the storage norm as a check: an undeclared location, a wrong tracked state, the same bytes in two stores, or any edit to the frozen handoff deliverable. Run with --self-test to confirm it can still fail
gates.lastLine: OK - every classified file is in a declared place with the declared tracked state.

gates.name: no constant is declared in more than one file
gates.why: D-12/D-44: a reader carrying its own copy of a format constant cannot notice the format changed; this scan found 2 of 5 sites by declaration and the other 2 by inline comparison
gates.lastLine: nobody re-reads. Export from one place and import it from the others.

gates.name: no local branch is stale or diverged
gates.why: a local branch behind its remote is how a commit lands on a 199-commit-old base
gates.lastLine: the guard that matters is the pre-push hook on a developer machine.
